translations.text: Look at the large building over there.

candidates.text: Venez après-demain.

translations.text: Come the day after tomorrow.
Please come the day after tomorrow.

candidates.text: Regardez cette photo, s'il vous plaît.

translations.text: Please take a look at that picture.
Look at this picture, please.

candidates.text: Venez avec nous.

translations.text: Come along with us.
Come with us.

candidates.text: Venez quand vous voulez.

translations.text: Come whenever you like.
Please come whenever you like.

candidates.text: Venez me voir quand vous le désirez.

translations.text: Come and see me whenever you like.

candidates.text: Venez le jour qui vous convient.

translations.text: Come on any day you like.

candidates.text: Venez prendre le thé avec moi.

translations.text: Come and have tea with me.

candidates.text: Venez nous rendre visite si vous passez dans le coin.

translations.text: Be sure to drop in on us if you come our way.

candidates.text: Regardez ce tableau, s'il vous plaît.

translations.text: Look at the picture.
Please take a look at this picture.

candidates.text: Regardez le bébé dormir dans le lit.

translations.text: Look at a baby sleeping in the bed.

candidates.text: Regardez, voilà votre mère qui vient.

translations.text: Look, here comes your mother.

candidates.text: Regardez devant vous, je vous prie.

translations.text: Look forward, please.
Look straight ahead.

candidates.text: Regardez alentour avant de traverser la route.

translations.text: Look both ways before you cross the street.
Look both ways before crossing the road.

candidates.text: Regardez-moi, s'il vous plaît.

translations.text: Please look at me.
Look at me, please.

candidates.text: Regardez les trains pour Londres dans la table des horaires.

translations.text: Look up the trains to London in the timetable.

candidates.text: Regardez cet immeuble rouge.

translations.text: Look at that red building.
